consumes.note: Each identity.profile is a lane-04 p2-placement-v1 profile fragment. It deliberately omits identity, cohort, family_lane, accepted_gates and notes, which lane 02/04 own. Terrain/space/water/home/helper facts are source-contract only: no native XYZ/terrain/route evidence is claimed, so every (slot, identity) pair stays denied.

Armor.placement_note: Ground-only. Emerges from and burrows into ground (Appear/Dive), so the slot needs burrow_ground. No nest/child anchor and no spawned helpers. Surface presence is capped at four at day end (EFlag_DayEndMax4).

ElecBug.placement_note: Ground-only, no burrow. Discharge pairs two separately spawned beetles through reciprocal mPartner pointers (startChargeState/startChildChargeState); the partner is not a spawned child, so helper_budget stays 0, but a slot that must show the electric behaviour needs at least two ElecBug spawns in the same arena. Electrical emission/damage is lane 10/11.

Imomushi.placement_note: Ground-only. Appears from and dives into ground (Appear/Dive). Climbs living fruit plants within its home-centred territory (getRandFruitsPlant/startClimbPlant) and eats Tsuyukusa, so berry predation additionally requires a compatible plant actor in the stage; this is a behaviour dependency, not a nest anchor. No spawned helpers.

TamagoMushi.placement_note: Ground/underground. Appears from and hides in ground (Appear/Hide). Its natural placement is a group: the manager caps surface groups at 10 and cave groups at TAMAGOMUSHI_GROUP_COUNT (30), so helper_budget is 10 for surface slots and 30 for cave slots. A lone TamagoMushi is only the group leader frame; Egg (id 37) and BigFoot (id 69) are the usual spawners (child counts 10 and 30). The current surface slot table models helper_capacity 0, so this helper_budget marks a real slot-table gap before a group identity can be placed.

Sokkuri.placement_note: Amphibious: MoveGround on land and MoveWater while inside a WaterBox (underwater move speed, upward buoyancy, splash/bubble effects). Terrains therefore include ground, mixed shore and submerged water; min_water_depth is 0 because it also walks on land. No burrow, no nest anchor, no helpers.

Hana.placement_note: Ground-only. Hidden while buried (mBuried / Sleep state; setUnderGround/resetUnderGround) and wakes on nearby Olimar or Pikmin, so the slot needs burrow_ground. ChappyBase-derived body with three 30-radius mouth slots and a 75-radius root collision, the largest ground-invertebrate footprint; it still fits the default 100 slot radius. No nest anchor and no spawned helpers.
